market_note: Stablecoin supply keeps climbing toward $1T by year-end: USDT nears $189B after another $1B mint, while USDC targets $150B in H2 2026.

stablecoin_items.headline: Tether mints another $1B USDT
stablecoin_items.summary: Tether pushed total USDT supply to roughly $189 billion with a fresh 1B mint on Aug 10, an on-chain event now routine for the market leader.

stablecoin_items.headline: Circle wins NY trust charter, eyes $150B USDC
stablecoin_items.summary: Circle's New York Trust entity received a limited-purpose trust charter from NYDFS on Jul 31, adding custody powers as it targets $150B USDC supply in H2 2026.

stablecoin_items.headline: USDC growing faster than USDT
stablecoin_items.summary: USDC supply is up 73% year-over-year versus USDT's 36%, though USDT and USDC together still hold 93% of the roughly $308B stablecoin market.

stablecoin_items.headline: GENIUS Act rulemaking grinds on
stablecoin_items.summary: A year after passage, OCC and FDIC are still drafting implementing rules; OCC issued a new proposed rulemaking on stablecoin issuance and FDIC has 144 open questions for issuers.

hack_items.headline: Coinsbuy exchange loses $7.9M in cross-chain drain
hack_items.summary: Hot wallets on Ethereum and TRON were drained almost simultaneously on Aug 9; attacker laundered ~79% of funds via FixedFloat into Monero before Coinsbuy refilled balances within 24 hours.

hack_items.headline: Coldcard firmware flaw drains $116M in Bitcoin
hack_items.summary: A five-year-old firmware bug in Coinkite's Coldcard hardware wallet let an attacker steal 1,816 BTC from 5,200 addresses since Jul 30 — now the third-largest crypto hack of 2026.

hack_items.headline: Two bridges hacked in one day, $31.5M lost
hack_items.summary: AFX Trade and Verus cross-chain bridges were hit within hours of each other on Jul 22-23; AFX lost $24.15M to compromised validator keys, Verus lost $7.54M to a reused exploit.

hack_items.headline: 2026 already the worst year on record for hacks
hack_items.summary: With 164 separate incidents logged through early August, 2026 has surpassed every prior full year, pushing cumulative 2026 losses past $1.2B.
